purpose: Lets the user type to filter a long list and choose one option, or optionally enter their own value.

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>
props.description: Options to filter and choose from

props.name: allowsCustomValue
props.description: Accepts text that matches no option

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error below the field; sets the error state

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called as the user types, for loading options from a server

whenToUse: For long lists, such as countries or people, where typing is faster than scrolling
When the user may know the value and want to type it
whenNotToUse: For free text with no list — use Input or SearchField
antiPatterns: Using it for fewer than about fifteen options
Filtering on every keystroke against a slow server without debouncing

anatomy: Label above; 40px text field with a chevron IconButton; the shared list box popover with a No results empty state; helper or error text
typography: Value and options `type-body1-size`; label `type-label-size`; empty state `type-body2-size`
states: Field: `color-border-input`, `color-border-input-hover`, focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`, error `color-border-danger`; list: `shadow-component-menu`, `color-state-layer`, selected `color-text-link`
motion: Popover enters with `motion-easing-enter` and exits with `motion-easing-exit`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: role combobox with aria-autocomplete list, named by the label
Arrow Down opens and moves, Enter chooses, Escape closes and restores
The empty state is announced inside the list box
